description: Edit this advertiser's ad card. Pass only the fields to change; anything omitted keeps its current value. WRITE TOOL, and it costs something: saving resets the card's status to 'pending', so the ad STOPS running until a person approves it again. Say that to the user and get their agreement before calling this. Caps: name 40 characters, tagline 60, one-sentence body 160, url must be https, domain must be a bare hostname like myapp.com. House style: plain words, no exclamation marks, and the sentence says what the product does rather than why it is good.

body.description: One sentence saying what the product does.

domain.description: Bare hostname, e.g. myapp.com. The card takes its logo and colour from here.

name.description: The app name shown on the card.

tagline.description: Four or five words, sits under the name.

url.description: Where the card links to. Must be https.

name: update_creative
